definitions.definition: (transitive) To draw conclusions from examining; to assess; to appraise.

quote.citation: 2005, Elisabeth Kübler-Ross, David Kessler, On Grief and Grieving, →ISBN, page 151:
quote.text: Death is a factor that changes all our views as we are forced to evaluate our worth and what ultimately matters in life.

definitions.definition: (transitive, mathematics, computing) To compute or determine the value of (an expression).
(intransitive, computing, mathematics) To return or have a specific value.

quote.citation: 2006, Lev Sabinin, Larissa Sbitneva, Ivan Shestakov, Non-Associative Algebra and Its Applications, CRC Press, →ISBN, page 201:
quote.text: Since element (15.1) evaluates to an element of the center in any alternative algebra, (15.1) has to evaluate to a scalar multiple of the identity element of the Cayley-Dickson algebra.

quote.citation: 2007, James E. Gentle, Matrix Algebra: Theory, Computations, and Applications in Statistics, Springer Science & Business Media, →ISBN, page 165:
quote.text: In one type of such an integral, the integrand is only the probability density function, and the integral evaluates to a probability, which of course is a scalar.
